interpretation: No case-completion advantage observed in this small trial. Concrete revised improvements concern first-attempt archival, explicit stale-state warnings and machine-readable reuse provenance. Scientific reasoning and authorization boundaries were met in both conditions.
limits: One agent per condition, five synthetic cases, no no-skill control, no repeated trials, no pinned model revision or matched measured token budget; no causal claim about broad agent quality, host compatibility or long-term research efficacy.
